The questions you're already asking.

How do I take The Gut Gummy?
Adults 18 years and older, enjoy 2 delicious gummies daily any time of day, with or without food. You can enjoy 4 to 6 daily for faster results.
Why should I eat The Gut Gummy each day?
You're home to around 38 trillion microorganisms, more than the 30 trillion human cells in your body. This microscopic community, known as the microbiome, helps break down food and supports the production of key vitamins, neurotransmitters, and compounds that influence mood, metabolism, immune function, and the body's natural inflammatory balance. The Gut Gummy is a next-gen Full-Spectrum Tribiotic, combining clinically studied prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics to support a healthy microbiome and promote total-body wellness, from digestive comfort and metabolic balance to GLP-1 support, skin health, mood, and immune resilience.*
What does The Gut Gummy do?
The Gut Gummy is a full-spectrum tribiotic gummy that supports your gut and whole-body wellness through clinically studied prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics. It promotes digestive comfort, metabolic balance, immune resilience, and skin clarity, while also supporting mood, GLP-1 pathways, and energy from within.* One of its key ingredients, the postbiotic BPL1® HT, has been clinically shown to help reduce belly and visceral fat and support healthy weight management in human studies* (Pedret et al., 2019).
How does The Gut Gummy uniquely increase microbiome diversity, and why is that so important?

Your gut is more than an organ. It's a living garden of trillions of microorganisms quietly shaping digestion, metabolism, mood, immunity, and energy. Modern life, stress, processed foods, and medications can deplete the microbial diversity your inner ecosystem needs to thrive.

The Gut Gummy nurtures your gut like a master gardener:

  • Clinically studied prebiotics (FOS, Inulin, IMOs, Tapioca Fiber, Pectin, Allulose) act like rich fertilizer, feeding a variety of beneficial bacteria to support a more vibrant, resilient, and diverse microbiome.*
  • DE111® probiotic delivers a resilient, beneficial strain that supports your gut's natural defenses and helps create an environment where more healthy microbes can flourish.*
  • BPL1® postbiotic helps nourish the internal environment of your gut, supporting microbial balance and a healthy inflammatory response.*

The Gut Gummy is daily nourishment for your inner garden, helping you cultivate wellness from within, naturally.

When will I feel something?
Clinical research on DE111®, a key probiotic strain in The Gut Gummy, shows it begins supporting antioxidant activity, digestive function, and immune response within just 4 hours of consumption* (Colom et al., 2023). Many individuals report reduced bloating and more regular digestion within the first few days of consistent use. With continued daily intake, longer-term benefits begin to take shape. In a human clinical trial, the postbiotic BPL1® HT was shown to significantly reduce visceral fat and waist circumference in adults with abdominal obesity (Pedret et al., 2019). Additional benefits may include support for appetite regulation through GLP-1 pathways, as well as improvements in mood, skin clarity, immune resilience, and athletic recovery.*
Who should take The Gut Gummy?
The Gut Gummy is designed for adults ages 18+.
Is The Gut Gummy compatible with my dietary restrictions?
The Gut Gummy is sugar-free, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, has no artificial flavors, artificial sweeteners, or artificial colors, is non-GMO, and contains no soy ingredients.
Can I take The Gut Gummy with other supplements or medications?
The Gut Gummy is not only safe to take with other supplements, but by improving your digestion it may enhance the bioavailability of other supplements. There are no known contradictions with The Gut Gummy and any over-the-counter or prescription medications, but we encourage anyone taking any medications to always check with their nutritionally oriented physician before use.
Can I take The Gut Gummy if pregnant or breastfeeding?
As with any dietary supplement, we recommend consulting your physician or OB/GYN before using The Gut Gummy during pregnancy or while breastfeeding. Current research suggests that prebiotics, probiotics, and postbiotics are generally safe for healthy pregnant and lactating individuals, with no evidence of increased risk for adverse outcomes. Still, it's always best to make that decision in partnership with your healthcare provider.
Do I need to refrigerate The Gut Gummy?
No. The Gut Gummy is specially formulated to require no refrigeration.
